normative_scope: Directed synthetic benchmark that freezes parent-level signal construction, nested exact-prefix windows, RNG lineage, condition grid, future AFINO execution and estimands before any series are generated.

f1_7_hypothesis_source.hypothesis: En ventanas cortas, aumentar el soporte espectral manteniendo la misma señal y el mismo proceso de ruido debería elevar principalmente ΔBIC₀,₁, porque la mejora de likelihood de M1 observada aquí no compensa el resto de penalización frente a M0; si la hipótesis es correcta, el margen frente a M0 crecerá más que el margen frente a M2 y aparecerán cruces conjuntos de los dos umbrales.

validated_generator_source.future_role: Regenerate only each validated N=120 paired noise/phase block during the future series-generation task.

frozen_f1_1_specification.role: Normative source for the validated noise generator, RNG, seed metadata and unchanged AFINO protocol.

hypothesis.statement: When real cadences from the same underlying realization are appended, the increase in spectral support will modify primarily the evidence for M1 against M0 and may produce joint crossings of both frozen BIC thresholds.
hypothesis.direction_not_assumed: Longer windows are not assumed to improve selection. The observed direction and magnitude of every paired change will be reported.

ground_truth.NULL_FLARE_RED_NOISE: Unit baseline plus the single frozen parent flare envelope and one validated N=120 red-noise realization; no periodic component.
ground_truth.STATIONARY_QPP_PRESENT: The same parent baseline, envelope, noise and phase, with one stationary sinusoid of period 50 s or 80 s and qpp_fraction 0.04.
ground_truth.interpretation_limit: Ground truth is synthetic by construction and is neither observational performance nor established physical QPP truth.

parent_noise_and_phase.noise_normalization_scope: The validated generator standardizes the noise once at N=120 to sample mean zero and sample standard deviation 0.005 using ddof=1.
parent_noise_and_phase.child_noise_rule: Every child receives the exact parent noise prefix. It is never recentered, rescaled or restandardized at child N.
parent_noise_and_phase.repeated_measures_statement: Ground-truth type, period and all six N values derived from one (alpha, data_seed) block are repeated measures.
parent_noise_and_phase.no_redraw_rule: A future non-finite or invalid parent block is retained as a generation failure and is not replaced with another seed.

qpp.phase_reuse: The same phase_rad from the parent block is used for both periods.

construction_order: Construct E(t) once over all 120 parent times.
Use the validated parent noise and phase once.
Construct one null parent and two positive parents.
Extract every child only after parent flux construction.

nested_windows.byte_identity_definition: Equality is exact for contiguous little-endian float64 payload bytes; no tolerance-based comparison is sufficient.

design_grid.ordering_rule: Order by n_samples, then red_noise_alpha, then NULL, P=50 s, P=80 s.

future_afino_protocol.protocol_source: unchanged frozen baseline and F1.1 specification

estimands.formal_m1_period_error_scope: Positive conditions only; the formal M1 center is reported for every valid execution and is not called recovered unless selected.

threshold_definitions.m0_threshold_crossing: A paired transition from delta_bic_0_1 <= 10.0 to > 10.0 or the reverse, with direction recorded.
threshold_definitions.m2_threshold_crossing: A paired transition from delta_bic_2_1 <= 10.0 to > 10.0 or the reverse, with direction recorded.
threshold_definitions.joint_threshold_crossing: A paired transition in the frozen double-BIC decision, with direction recorded.

support_hypothesis_contrast.descriptive_support_rule: The F1.7 hypothesis receives descriptive support for a transition when this contrast is positive and margin_vs_m0 increases.

estimands.paired_analysis_rule: All changes across N are computed within the same parent alpha, period and data_seed before aggregation. Different N values are never treated as independent realizations.

predeclared_limits: Extending the prefix adds mainly flare tail and noise after the early peak.
The realized variance of each child prefix is not fixed exactly at 0.005.
AFINO internal normalization and the Hann window change with n_samples.
FFT frequency support and bin locations change with n_samples.
The benchmark identifies the total effect of extending the nested observation, not a mathematically pure effect of bin count.
Different n_samples windows are repeated measurements of the same parent realization.
This version does not study damping, gaps, irregular sampling or cadence changes.
The two periods and qpp_fraction are fixed and do not span all QPP morphologies.
structural_checks_required_before_series: F1.7 audit, F1.2 generator and F1.1 specification hashes match.
Exactly 18 null and 36 positive conditions exist.
Null period_s and qpp_fraction fields are empty.
Exactly 720 null, 1440 positive and 2160 total series are planned.
Exactly 6480 primary, 1458 stability and 7938 total model calls are planned.
Exactly 120 independent parent noise/phase blocks are planned.
Every parent signal is built at N=120 before any prefix is extracted.
Every child prefix is byte-identical to the corresponding parent prefix.
No child noise is recentered, rescaled or restandardized.
No series is silently regenerated after a parent-generation failure.
No AFINO result is inspected before the design and materialized dataset are frozen.

substantive_change_requires_new_version: parent block RNG or draw order
versioning_rule.substantive_change_action: Create a new benchmark version and new artifact hashes; never overwrite version 1.0.0.
versioning_rule.typographical_change_action: Publish a separate erratum linked to the frozen hashes and demonstrate that generation, execution and interpretation are unchanged.
